provenance.moves: Canonical Generation 5 move IDs; do not substitute another hack numbering table.
provenance.speciesForms: PK5 raw form values and B2W2 form order are pinned in gen5_save_form_ids.json and cross-checked against clean White 2 plus final-ROM a/0/1/6 personal-table form indexes.
provenance.items: Generation 5 item slots inherit the pinned Black 2/White 2 identity table. VW2R explicitly overrides slots 110, 260, and 622 as Link Cable, Ice Stone, and Old Sea Map.
